title: Tiger 850 Sport (Explorer Pack)
description: The Triumph Tiger 850 Sport (Explorer Pack) is engineered for uncompromised trans-continental exploration, positioned in the Adventure Tourer segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 850cc engine generating 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 193 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck riding stance and a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
